title: [Pre Order] PlayStation 5 Pro Bundle $1638 Delivered @ BIG W
body:
Deal: [Pre Order] PlayStation 5 Pro Bundle $1638 Delivered @ BIG W

[dan0909] this site has become Ozadvertising now. 70% posts are BS advertising and barely 5-10% real bargains i find (compared to pre-covid).
[SickDmith] Not sure where the bargain is
SSD is shuckable?
[ruckus211] This is the only way to pre order one right now.
The bargain is that it’s cheaper than purchasing it from a scalper. 🙃
[bargainatoraah] DLSS is due soon and will negate the difference
[Dashedlh007] Nope DLSS is Nvidia, however XSX is getting FSR 4.1 which will bring it somewhat close to ps5 pros PSSR2
[bargainatoraah] Pretty sure Xbox are targeting a GTA6 release timing for FSR
[dan0909] in terms of practicle results DLSS isn't a biggie. just minor improvement.
[incipient] Hahaha that's insane. Can't legitimately neg it…but hahaha
[wshinji] Jbhifi getting a handful of units in throughout the past week. Should call around!
[t0087669] yes I just called a couple of JBs near me and one had 4 instock. got even more lucky got invoiced as FC bundle so it was 1199.
[topherboi] I picked one up from my local yesterday (last one in stock) and they are doing checks to make sure scalpers aren't eligible.
[dealsforlife] Understand that the Pro was out of stock for a while but this isn't a bargain.
[Wiadro] why is this a deal?
its not cheaper than retail.
FFS
Your negative votes have been revoked 3 times over the last 90 days, and you are not able to vote negative until 19 November at 16:04.
[The One Demon] Incorrectly. Ozbargain has become a place for retail prices and barely better than retail prices… Bargains barely exist on this site anymore…
[bargainatoraah] Perhaps that’s the economy. It’s also a place where people find stuff they want that’s hard to get. That’s a bargain for some.
[Wip3out] Anyone considering this should just accept they've missed the boat, you've had years to buy one - they were $600 used on marketplace before the price hike - crazy to pay this price now.
[softwhite] Never saw a disc pro for anywhere near 600 anywhere
[plmko] Yeah that's bullshit. Lowest price on Ebay history was $890ish.
[Wip3out] Well I got one for $600 off FB MP at the end of March, but yeah without a disc drive. (Given GTA 6 would be the main/only reason anybody would buy this right now ,the DD is is just a forced up-sell by Big W anyway)
A mate got one via a FB MP post I sent him with a disc drive and a few games (including BF6 and Yotei) for $800 shortly after. So they were definitely around if you were looking at the time.
Not that it matters now anyway, but just highlighting how absurd the FOMO is atm.
If you buy now, you'd be best off finishing GTA 6 and selling it asap, you probably wouldn't be too out of pocket - especially if done before Xmas when stock will likely be limited still.
[YoursTruly] Sony: digital future.
Jailbreakers: yes.
[Rebsphere] This is $1000 more than the ps5 was. Is the Pro really worth it? Might as well just buy a PC if you need the extra power for gaming.
[Smigit] “Was” being a key word there. The disc based PS5 is now $1000 also.
PC prices aren’t any better but with what’s happening with RAM, storage and video cards. Besides, I bet 80% of people looking to get a 6 year old console for $1000+ right now are doing so to play GTA VI, and for now it’s a console exclusive so a PC probably isn’t what the buyers of this are after.
Plenty of concerns that a lot of people will just be priced out of the hobby at the rate things are going.
[EitherWayUp] Folks will just stop playing new games are start working backwards down the emulation train.
[RichardL] Technically the original PS1 is codenamed the PSX.
[Wiadro] This is a PSX
I was more taking about PS10 or X as the Roman numeral
[perhaps] Just hoping GTA6 comes on PC soon. This pricing for a console is farked.
[Randomrayven] is there a tutorial to set this up?? also how can i get game’ zip file
[Spendmore] Ahem have you seen the price of pc components ?
[TheDukeOfNukem] Not sure where the bargain is
Me neither
[Raynes] A product being available to purchase is a bargain??
That's what passes for a bargain these days?
[AE] Hard pass and shouldn't even be mentioned. We are getting close to double RRP.
[Winny182] Not when Sony themselves set the RRP to $1,399?
[plmko] From my experience how Playstation stock works you won't find any more stock from now until February next year.
So if you absolutely must have one for Christmas then this is as good as any chance left.
[muzzamo] Assuming they come through with the goods.
I had a terrible time with Harvey Norman pre ordering the pro.
They told me PlayStation deliveries are like delivery from Apple. They get allocations occasionally, have no idea how much it will be until it arrives at the store.
This makes the preordering concept useless. The harvey Norman I was dealing with last had a delivery of a couple in June!
Jb are much more reliable and stock has been trickling into stores in the last week.
[plmko] I would have no worries with Big W though. Returns are easy so just buy another if a better deals come around.
[Winny182] While not a bargain this is better than EB locking theirs behind their subscription and forcing you to buy 2 years of their “extra coverage”
[Fredfloresjr] Agree, but just have to wait til 27/11 and surely nothing is guaranteed. Could be earlier or later.
[sticky8anana] thanks OP, pay day this week, gonna buy a couple and put on marketplace. nice investment
[bugsbargains] And I felt guilty for spending $900 on mine in 2025..
